description: Dual-signal confirmation strategy combining deep_level_ratio (ratio of deep book levels 3-5 vs all levels) with L1 book_imbalance. Only enters when both signals agree on direction within the first 2 seconds. Analyzed using Up token only (Down is perfect mirror).
hypothesis: Combine deep_level_ratio (2s window, threshold 0.3) with book_imbalance as confirmation filter. Only enter when both agree on direction. Dual-signal confirmation should reduce false positives and improve win rate at the cost of fewer trades.
next_steps: Sample results promising (62% WR, Sharpe 3.5 on 71 trades from 401 resolved markets). Key caveats: (1) sample is only 401 markets - validate on full 7,187-file dataset to confirm edge persists out-of-sample, (2) sensitivity analysis shows monotonic improvement as imbalance threshold tightens at dr=0.10, suggesting real signal not noise, (3) deep_ratio alone carries most alpha (57.5% WR at thresh=0.10) while imbalance acts as quality filter, (4) test with different entry windows (1s, 3s, 5s) to optimize timing, (5) investigate whether signal decays over market lifetime or strengthens.
